item.title: How to Find Content Gaps Using Clarity and Google Search Console
item.description: Most content decisions are guesses. You write about topics you think matter, but without data, you don’t know if visitors actually engage with your posts, or what they’re searching for but not finding. This guide teaches you to combine two powerful data sources — Microsoft Clarity (real user behaviour) and Google Search Console (search intent) — to build a data-backed content strategy. Claude automates the analysis, surfacing gaps, quick wins, and problems worth fixing.
